verdict.rationale: All options satisfy an after-late-morning departure and Monday-evening arrival. B is cheapest but uses OAK and leaves earliest; A leaves latest at a modest premium to B but arrives latest; D arrives somewhat earlier than A/B for a modestly higher fare; C arrives earliest but costs substantially more. The prompt supplies no weighting for airport convenience, departure flexibility, arrival-time value, connection-risk tolerance, or fare sensitivity.
